result.one_liner: Bright Data is a web data collection platform providing residential proxies, datacenter proxies, SERP API, and web scraping services.
result.notes: Bright Data offers automatic free trial (14-30 days) and recurring 5,000 credits/month free tier for Web Unlocker, SERP API, Web Scraper, and Scraper Studio. Self-serve signup with immediate API access. Usage-based pricing for additional credits.

evidence.quote: An API key is a secure hashed token used to authenticate with Bright Data API, with a default key created automatically upon account creation.
Native Access - Authenticate and interact with the Bright Data platform using proxy protocol username and password.
the CLI implements four distinct authentication methods: Loopback OAuth2 for local machines, Device Flow optimized for headless environments, Direct API Key
Everyone who signs up to Bright Data automatically gets a free trial, which can be used for all Bright Data products.
Every new account also gets a recurring free tier of 5,000 credits per month for the Web Unlocker API, SERP API, Web Scraper API and Scraper Studio
REST endpoints expose session inventory (GET /browser_sessions) for observability and lifecycle inspection
